Read sections 2 and 3 together to test both an ordinary-license classification and a second-entity interpretation. challenge.results: Invalidating the pinned legal code breaks the claim’s binding to the specified publisher revision, even with matching live bytes. Invalidating the index scope removes the governing criterion for `related-instrument`, even with the publisher classification intact. Section 3 expressly depends on section 2 and operates within the same titled instrument. It supplies neither a basis to classify the whole edition as an ordinary license nor a separate catalog identity. SPDX controls its own list membership and identifiers. The repository’s “NOT YET ACTIVE” note concerns serving the generated `docs/` data. The live response establishes public availability of the exact edition and supplies no evidence that a particular rights holder applied it to a particular work.

limitations: The assessment covers the pinned English edition. Applying CC0 to a particular work requires evidence connecting an affirmer to that work. Legal effect in a particular jurisdiction requires a separate assessment.
